services.name: Sunset Night Trip
services.desc: Rates Private Charter : $130 All ages, Up to 6 People Duration 1 Hours About We will leave out of Madisonville at sunset and travel down the bayou. The swamp comes alive at night and Capt Mike will take you into the backwaters using a commercial spot light to light up the bayou showing alligators when they are most actively hunting at night. You will be given a spotlight and will see the gators eyes glowing and hear the gators and bullfrogs calling out. This is a must see! What’s included: Life jackets Phone charging stations Spotlights Comfortable seating 162 quart ice chest for keeping your drinks and food cool Please bring: Food and drinks Sunscreen Sunglasses Hat

services.name: 2 Hour Boat Trip
services.desc: Rates Private Charter $225 All ages, Up to 6 People Duration 2 Hours About Explore the Tchefuncte River with expert local guide Capt Mike! Capt Mike has spent his life learning the river and will provide a fun experience for all. Board a 24ft long, fully covered Bentley pontoon boat, food and drink welcomed. Optional bathroom stops will be every 40mins. Tours/ Boat Days are both offered. Tours will explain the unique history of this river town, as we travel along the Tchefuncte we will detour through passage ways viewing beautiful cypress stands covered in Spanish moss, winding in and out of several bayous. Capt Mike knows where all the Wildlife such as Alligators, turtles, fish eagles,

services.name: Three Hour Trip

On the return, we’ll be exploring tributaries off the main channel. Includes trip and history of the area. services.name: 1.5 Hour River Excursion
services.desc: About Five star ratings. Boat excursion on Tchefuncte river via party barge! Explore the scenic river system, learn about the areas rich in Native American and maritime history, view wildlife. See costal areas, marshes, bayous and the largest scenic river in the State. Stops at several popular waterfront restaurants optional(including: The Anchor-casual dining & Daiquiris bar, Morton’s- seafood, The Blind Tiger- costal Restaurant and T Rivers bar & grill- for those picking up lunch/ dinner to go.
